text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's give it our all as "seven 
spices of one heart"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Is something off? Was it 
Six-flavor spice? No, Five-flavor... 
Four-flavor...?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! 'United in purpose' (Ichi-mi 
Dou-shin)~!! Tahaha. I did tend to skip 
classes on four-character idioms, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You're still nowhere near the President's 
level, Tsuyoshi! I mean, during her 
assembly speeches, she drops five 
four-character idioms in a single minute!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to learn more difficult words 
too. And then someday, I'll become a 
Triple Crown Umamusume just like the 
President—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Ehehe. Now, this between us is 
'strictly confidential', okay?
